1-voucher-posting.dataScale: 1000 vouchers per round (single businessType AP_INVOICE; multi-type mix is successor refinement)
1-voucher-posting.seedProfile: 12 batches × 1000 unique PostingEvents pre-built outside timing window; each round consumes one batch (idempotency requires unique billCode per round)
1-voucher-posting.notes: Variance exceeds threshold. Driver: H2 dataset growth (each round appends 1000 vouchers → later rounds scan larger tables) + GC pressure as heap fills. Registered as path C (JMH) upgrade candidate (plan Phase 2 exit criteria; design doc §3.4 successor hook).

2-period-close.target: IErpFinAccountingPeriodBiz.closePeriod (preCheck + AR/AP/INV/AST/GL module close + FX reval + PL transfer + trial balance)
2-period-close.dataScale: 2000 GL lines (1000 vouchers × 2 lines) per period; period reverse-close + close cycle per round
2-period-close.seedProfile: Seed period + subjects + 1000 posted vouchers + 1 open AR-EUR (for FX reval); per-round reset: finalize→reverseClose (untimed) before next close
2-period-close.notes: Variance exceeds threshold. Driver: close is fast (~30ms) → sub-50ms timing dominated by JIT/GC/scheduling jitter; voucher accumulation across rounds (each close+reverse adds reversal pairs) adds mild growth bias. Registered as path C (JMH) upgrade candidate (plan Phase 5 exit criteria; design doc §3.4 successor hook). Data scale adjudicated 10000→2000 GL lines (H2 localDb + closePeriod multi-stage heavy; plan §Phase 5 「具体在 Phase 2 plan 裁决」).

3-inv-reclose.target: IErpInvCostingBiz.reclosePeriodCosts (scan DONE FIFO moves + recompute missing cost layers + flush)
3-inv-reclose.dataScale: 500 incoming moves × 20 FIFO materials (all missing cost layers); reset cost layers per round
3-inv-reclose.seedProfile: Seed 20 FIFO materials + period + subjects; costing-off generates 500 DONE incoming moves (no layers); per-round reset: delete all cost layers (untimed) before next reclose
3-inv-reclose.notes: Variance exceeds threshold. Driver: reclose issues 500×~4 H2 queries (moves/lines/ledgers/layers) per round → ~2000 queries/round; H2 in-memory query time has high variance under heap pressure. Registered as path C (JMH) upgrade candidate (plan Phase 4 Decision: 首期裁决=登记 successor; design doc §3.4 successor hook). Data scale adjudicated 5000→500 moves / 50→20 materials (generateMove full pipeline ~50-100ms/move makes N=5000 seed >500s; plan §Phase 4 「具体在 Phase 2 plan 裁决」).

4-report-render.target: ErpFinReportBizModel.renderHtml per report (6 reports: balance-sheet / income-statement / cash-flow-statement / ar-ap-aging / period-close-report / budget-vs-actual)
4-report-render.dataScale: 1 report per measurement; 6 reports independently measured (K=2 warmup + N=10 timed each)
4-report-render.seedProfile: Seed period + 6 subjects + GL balances + 1 posted voucher + 1 open AR + period status + 2 bill-R; reuse for all 6 reports
4-report-render.notes: All 6 reports exceed threshold. Driver: sub-millisecond render time → (max-min)/median amplifies tiny absolute jitter (e.g. balance-sheet median 1.85ms with max-min≈0.83ms → 45% variance). Absolute timings stable enough for >5x regression detection. Registered as path C (JMH) upgrade candidate (plan Phase 3 exit criteria; design doc §3.4 successor hook).

summary.overallVerdict: All 4 paths registered as path C (JMH) upgrade candidates (plan Phase 4 Decision: 首期裁决=登记 successor). First-baseline @Test timing data captured as regression-detection baseline; absolute medians stable enough for >5x regression detection even though (max-min)/median exceeds §4 thresholds due to H2 in-memory + sub-ms timing noise. JMH upgrade + production-grade load test are independent successors (design doc §9).
